system.description:
• Effect: A new Performance option, costing 1 use, out of combat: creatures who can see and hear you (2 at 4th, 4 at 6th, 10 at 12th) make a Will save or are Fascinated: Incapacitated, and they do not move, while you perform (up to 10 minutes) and for a round after.
  • A creature that saves can't be Fascinated by you again that day.
  • An obvious threat, such as an attack on a Fascinated creature or its allies, breaks the effect.
  • 8th level: you may implant a Suggestion in a Fascinated creature as part of the performance; it saves with Disadvantage.
  • 15th level: a Mass Suggestion in every Fascinated creature, the same way.

activities.name: Fascinate
activities.text: A Performance option (1 use), out of combat: up to {1:1, 4:2, 6:4, 12:10} creatures that can see and hear you make a Will save or are Fascinated (Incapacitated, not moving) while you perform (up to 10 minutes) and for a round after. A creature that saves can't be Fascinated by you again that day. An obvious threat breaks it.

activities.name: Suggestion
activities.text: Implant a Suggestion in a Fascinated creature as part of the performance; it saves with Disadvantage.

activities.name: Mass Suggestion
activities.text: Implant a Mass Suggestion in every Fascinated creature the same way (each saves with Disadvantage).
